_endpoint_verified: 2026-08-21: 200 on a 32-token probe, served by DigitalOcean; declared max_completion_tokens 128000, quantization unknown
_note: Pinned to digitalocean for the Run C chunked-path leg of live-structural-round-2026-08-21.md. Probed 2026-08-21 with provider.only plus allow_fallbacks:false: digitalocean, novita/fp8 and siliconflow/fp8 returned 200; atlas-cloud/fp8 returned 404 'no endpoints available matching your guardrail restrictions and data policy'. DigitalOcean is the reachable US-hosted endpoint whose 128,000 declared ceiling clears the slug's 65,536 MODEL_OUTPUT_CAPS row with headroom, so every chunked batch call fits its real ceiling; novita/fp8 declares exactly 65,536 (no headroom over the resolved cap) and siliconflow does not match the hosting posture the account's data policy expresses. Quantization is unknown, so this leg is not quantization-attributable. Hand-fallback if DigitalOcean rate-limits: novita/fp8 at 0.269/0.40, which requires updating this file AND the price row in core/pricing.py together.
_pinning_rationale: Same F2 reasoning as the v4-pro fixture: MODEL_OUTPUT_CAPS is keyed per slug (65,536 for this one) while the slug's endpoints declare ceilings from 7,168 (SambaNova) to 163,840; an unpinned route below the resolved cap truncates non-empty and burns the repair budget. The whole point of this leg is that the 65,536 cap makes the chunked path fire on an over-cap skeleton, so the pin must be an endpoint whose real ceiling is at or above the cap.
